tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one full-body desire-1 visual-novel sprite of Faruzan. Use the supplied approved neutral as the sole image reference. Preserve her identity, skin tone, hair, costume, colours, accessories and rendering. Keep her at least as petite as the neutral with the same compact general body proportions; do not lengthen torso or legs. Give her a tender longing expression and open eyes, a subtle shy tilt and one hand near her collarbone; allow a genuinely different pose appropriate to the emotion. Both eyes visibly open; preserve the original irises and their colour and detail, with filled white heart-shaped pupils inside the irises, not floating symbols or catchlights. Her skirt and fabric panels hang naturally downward at rest; no windblown fabric. Keep gestures simple, hands near the torso with coherent palms and naturally grouped fingers, exactly two legs and feet, with feet separated or slightly staggered. Show the entire silhouette including hair, accessories and shoes, with roughly 2–4% top and bottom padding. Genuinely transparent background. No scenery, text, labels, UI, props, companions, detached effects, watermark or ground shadow.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create one fully clothed, full-body visual-novel character sprite of Faruzan. Use the supplied approved neutral as the only image reference. Preserve the reference character's identity, face, skin tone, hair, costume, colours, accessories and rendering. Keep her at least as petite as her neutral, with the same compact body proportions and no elongated torso or legs. In the center of each iris, draw one small, solid white heart silhouette as the pupil, matching in size and orientation; the hearts stay entirely within their respective irises. No extra hearts. Two coherent legs and feet, simple relaxed hands and a complete silhouette including hair, accessories and shoes; approximately 2–4% top and bottom padding. Polished anime illustration on a genuinely transparent background. No scenery, UI, text, props, floating effects, watermark or ground shadow.
